This project, which concerns all the winners of the Moroccan Universities, aims to improve the higher education system and raise it to the height of the country's ambitions. In this perspective, the proposed intervention is structured around five key actions, namely: (i) the realization of an inventory of Moroccan universities in terms of the information, orientation and monitoring system of the employability of the laureates together with a study on the evolution and specificities of the professional sector; (ii) the development of the competency framework and the definition of the guidelines; (iii) the development of a training manual for resource persons followed by the organization of training sessions; (iv) the development of a computer platform for monitoring the winners and a website for the project; (v) the evaluation of university observatories of employment and training.", "xml:lang": "en"}, {"text": "Le projet d'appui \u00e0 la mise en place d'un dispositif national d'accompagnement \u00e0 l'employabilit\u00e9 des laur\u00e9ats de l'Universit\u00e9 marocaine soutient les efforts du gouvernement marocain dans le d\u00e9veloppement des comp\u00e9tences et la r\u00e9duction de la pauvret\u00e9. Ce projet qui concerne l'ensemble des laur\u00e9ats des Universit\u00e9s Marocaines a pour but d\u2019am\u00e9liorer le syst\u00e8me d\u2019enseignement sup\u00e9rieur et le hisser \u00e0 la hauteur des ambitions du pays. Dans cette optique, l\u2019intervention propos\u00e9e s\u2019articule autour de 5 actions cl\u00e9s, \u00e0 savoir : (i) la r\u00e9alisation d\u2019un \u00e9tat des lieux des universit\u00e9s marocaines en termes du dispositif d\u2019information, d\u2019orientation et de suivi de l\u2019employabilit\u00e9 des laur\u00e9ats assorti d\u2019une \u00e9tude sur l'\u00e9volution et les sp\u00e9cificit\u00e9s du secteur professionnel ; (ii) l\u2019\u00e9laboration du r\u00e9f\u00e9rentiel de comp\u00e9tences et la d\u00e9finition des lignes directrices ; (iii) l\u2019\u00e9laboration d\u2019un Manuel de formation des personnes ressources suivi de l\u2019organisation de sessions de formation ; (iv) le d\u00e9veloppement d\u2019une plateforme informatique de suivi des laur\u00e9ats puis d\u2019un site web pour le projet ; (v) l\u2019\u00e9valuation des observatoires universitaires de l'emploi et de la formation.", "xml:lang": "fr"}]}, {"type": "2", "narrative": [{"text": "The main objective is to develop a mechanism to improve the employability of laureates and institutionalize it at the level of Moroccan universities by strengthening the skills of the resource persons accompanying the establishment of a national employment observatory. Specifically, it aims to: (i) Institutionalize university employment and training observatories as a university structure approved by university councils as the highest decision-making body, (ii) Provide them with material and human resources and the management tools necessary for their proper functioning, (iii) Provide decision-making bodies in the higher education and employment sector with comprehensive data on the employability of university graduates required for any decision-making process and (iv) Make available to the National Observatory of Employment and Training a database of trained and certified resource persons.", "xml:lang": "en"}, {"text": "L'objectif principal est de d\u00e9velopper un dispositif d\u2019am\u00e9lioration de l\u2019employabilit\u00e9 des laur\u00e9ats et l\u2019institutionnaliser au niveau des universit\u00e9s marocaines par le renforcement des comp\u00e9tences des personnes ressources accompagnant la mise en place d\u2019un observatoire national de l\u2019emploi. De fa\u00e7on sp\u00e9cifique, il s'agit de: (i) Institutionnaliser les observatoires universitaires de l\u2019emploi et de la formation comme structure universitaire approuv\u00e9e par les conseils des universit\u00e9s en tant que haute instance d\u00e9cisionnelle, (ii)Les doter des moyens mat\u00e9riels et humains et des outils de gestion n\u00e9cessaires \u00e0 leur bon fonctionnement, (iii)Mettre \u00e0 la disposition des instances d\u00e9cisionnelles du secteur de l\u2019enseignement sup\u00e9rieur et de l\u2019emploi des donn\u00e9es exhaustives sur l\u2019employabilit\u00e9s des dipl\u00f4m\u00e9s universitaires n\u00e9cessaire \u00e0 toute prise de d\u00e9cision et (iv)Mettre \u00e0 la disposition de l\u2019 Observatoire National de l\u2019Emploi et de la Formation une base de donn\u00e9es de personnes ressources form\u00e9es et certifi\u00e9es.", "xml:lang": "fr"}]}, {"type": "3", "narrative": [{"text": "The beneficiaries of the project are: the Moroccan Government, the <!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<script src="//d-portal.org/savi/lib/savi.js" type="text/javascript" charset="utf-8"></script>
<script> require("savi").start({ embeded:true }); </script>
</head>
<body class="print"><style>
*			{box-sizing:border-box; font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif; word-wrap:break-word;}
body		{background-color:#47506B; color:#FFF; margin-top:40px;}


.activity *, .org *			{box-sizing:border-box; font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif; word-wrap:break-word;}
.activity, .org				{background-color:rgba(0,14,32,0.7); border-radius:8px; box-sizing:border-box; color:#fff; margin:0 auto; margin-bottom:40px; padding:40px 40px 1px 40px; position:relative; width:960px;}
.activity > *, .org > *		{box-sizing:border-box;}
.activity a					{color:#FFC28A; text-decoration:none;}
.activity a:link			{color:#FFC28A; text-decoration:none;}
.activity a:visited			{color:#FFC28A; text-decoration:none;}
.activity a:hover			{color:#FFDBBB; text-decoration:none;}
.activity a:active			{color:#FFC28A; text-decoration:none;}
.org						{margin-top:40px;}
.org a						{color:#FFC28A; text-decoration:none;}
.org a:link					{color:#FFC28A; text-decoration:none;}
.org a:visited				{color:#FFC28A; text-decoration:none;}
.org a:hover				{color:#FFDBBB; text-decoration:none;}
.org a:active				{color:#FFC28A; text-decoration:none;}

/*	FLAGS	*/
.humanitarian	{background-color:#ff890c; color:#000e20; font-size:14px; left:0; padding:10px 40px 7px 40px; position:absolute; text-align:right; text-transform:uppercase; top:-10px;}
.hum_transaction{background-color:rgba(48,71,103,1); border-radius:4px; color:#CCC; display:inline-block; font-size:12px; margin-left:-5px; margin-top:10px; padding:2px 5px;}
span.withdrawn	{background-color:#ccc; border-radius:3px; color:#444; font-size:12px; font-style:italic; font-weight:normal; margin-left:5px; padding:2px 5px; text-transform:initial; vertical-align:baseline; width:initial;}

/*	THEME BUTTON	*/
.theme_button		{position:fixed; top:0px; right:0px; background-color:#000; color:#FFF; cursor:pointer; padding:5px 10px; font-size:14px;}
.theme_button:hover	{background-color:#666;}

/*	VERSION 1 BANNER	 */
a.banner_v1:link	{background-color:#c40000; border-radius:2px 2px 0 0; color:#fff; display:block; font-size:16px; margin-bottom:20px; padding:20px; text-align:center; text-decoration:none;}
a.banner_v1:visited	{color:#fff;}
a.banner_v1:hover	{background-color:#f00;}
a.banner_v1:active	{color:#fff;}

/*	HEADERS	*/
.header,
.header_doc		{border-bottom:1px solid #aaa; color:#ccc; display:block; font-size:13px; margin-bottom:20px; padding-bottom:10px; position:relative; text-transform:uppercase;}
.header_doc		{border:0; margin:0;}
.header_section	{background-color:rgba(17,46,105,1); box-sizing:border-box; color:#FFF; font-size:12px; margin:0 0 20px -50px; padding:10px 40px; text-transform:uppercase; width:980px;}
.flex_layout	{display:flex; justify-content:space-between;}
.bright			{background-color:rgba(38,67,128,1);}
.brighter		{background-color:transparent; border-bottom:2px solid #47506b; font-size:11px; line-height:20px; margin:auto; margin:5px 0 20px 0; padding:0; width:880px;}
.brighter span	{background-color:#47506b; display:inline; padding:5px 10px;}
.sticky			{position:sticky; top:-1px; z-index:2;}
.nostick		{position:initial;}
span.block		{display:block;}
.version		{display:block; font-size:12px; position:absolute; right:0; top:0;}
.version span	{color:#fff;}

/*	WRAPPERS	*/
.wrap_title						{padding-bottom:40px;}
.wrap_reporting_org				{color:#ccc; font-size:18px; line-height:1.35em; display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:baseline;}
.wrap_title	.narrative						{font-size:42px; line-height:1em;}
.wrap_title	.narrative:nth-of-type(n+2)		{font-size:30px; margin-top:15px; font-style:italic;}
.wrap_data_source				{background-color:rgba(0,14,32,0.7); color:#FFAB5E; font-size:18px; line-height:1.5em; margin:0 auto; margin:25px 0 0 -40px; padding:20px 40px; width:960px;}
.wrap_iati_identifier			{display:flex; justify-content:flex-start; align-items:baseline;}
.wrap_reporting_org .text,
.wrap_iati_identifier .text		{color:#ccc; font-size:13px; line-height:1.35em; text-transform:uppercase; width:15%;}
.wrap_iati_identifier .text a	{font-size:18px; padding-left:5px;}
.wrap_name_org					{color:#fff; font-size:18px; padding-bottom:10px;}
.wrap_name_org .narrative:nth-of-type(n+2)	{padding-top:5px; color:#ccc; font-size:16px; font-style:italic;}
.wrap_description				{margin:40px auto;}
.wrap_description .text			{margin-bottom:30px;}
.wrap_description .text .narrative					{font-size:1.0em; line-height:1.25em; unicode-bidi:embed; white-space:pre-line; word-spacing:0.05em;}
.wrap_description .text .narrative:nth-of-type(n+2)	{display:block; margin-top:15px; color:#ccc;}
.wrap_description .text .narrative:first-letter		{text-transform:capitalize;}
.wrap_default					{margin:0 auto; padding:20px 0 0 0;}
.wrap_default .text				{color:#ccc; display:inline-block; font-size:14px; vertical-align:top; width:50%;}
.wrap_default .text:first-of-type	{padding-right:20px;}
.wrap_default .text	span		{color:#fff; font-size:16px; padding-left:10px;}
.wrap_location .header_section,
.wrap_budget .header_section	{margin-top:0;}
.wrap_document					{margin:30px 0;}
.wrap_budget_not_provided		{font-size:16px; padding-bottom:20px;}
.wrap_budget_not_provided span	{font-weight:bold; text-transform:lowercase;}
.reporting_org					{width:85%; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between;}
.reporting_org span				{font-size:12px; margin:0; line-height:1.35em;}
.reporting_org .narrative:nth-of-type(2)	{font-style:italic;}

/*	GRAPHS	*/
.wrap_recipient_country,
.wrap_sector				{background-color:#fff; color:#444; margin:-20px 0 0 -40px; padding:0 0 40px 0; width:960px;}
.wrap_recipient_country		{padding:40px 0;}
.sector,
.sector_list_wrap					{color:#444; font-size:14px; line-height:18px; padding:0 40px;}
.sector_list_wrap span				{display:inline-block; padding-right:40px; vertical-align:top; width:30%;}
.sector_list_wrap span.withdrawn	{padding-right:5px; width:initial;}
.sector_list_wrap span.sector_list_description	{font-size:13px; line-height:15px; padding:0; width:70%;}
.sector_list		{border-bottom:1px solid #ddd; margin-bottom:10px; padding-bottom:10px;}
.sector_vocab		{border-bottom:1px solid #aaa; padding-bottom:20px;}
.sector_list:last-of-type,
.sector_vocab:last-of-type	{border:0; padding-bottom:0;}
.sector_vocab .type {margin-left:5px; background-color:rgba(223,222,217,0.6); vertical-align:baseline; color:#444; font-weight:normal;}
.wrap_code,
.wrap_bar			{display:inline-block; vertical-align:middle; width:400px;}
.wrap_code			{border-right:1px solid #999; padding:10px 20px 10px 0; text-align:right; width:480px;}
.wrap_bar			{height:24px;}
.wrap_code span		{display:inline-block; vertical-align:middle;}
.sector_code_text	{max-width:360px;}
.sector_code		{background-color:rgba(192,213,242,0.7); border-radius:4px; color:#222; font-size:11px; margin-left:10px; padding:2px 5px; white-space:nowrap;}
.sector_code:nth-of-type(3)	{margin-left:5px;}
.sector_bar,
.sector_value		{display:inline-block; vertical-align:middle;}
.sector_bar			{background-color:#05569d; height:24px; max-width:335px; position:relative;}
.sector_bar:before	{background-color:rgba(17,46,105,0.1); content:""; height:24px; left:0; position:absolute; top:0; width:335px;}
.sector_overlay		{height:24px; left:0; position:absolute; top:0;}
.sector_value		{color:#444; font-size:14px; margin-left:20px; max-width:36px; text-align:right; white-space:nowrap;}
.sector_value:after	{content:"%";}
.wrap_sector .header			{border:0; color:#444; font-weight:bold; margin:0 auto; padding:30px 0 5px 0; text-align:center; width:880px;}
.wrap_sector .header.glossary	{border-bottom:1px solid #aaa; margin-bottom:10px; text-align:left;}
.wrap_sector .subheader			{color:#555; font-size:12px; line-height:16px; margin:0 auto; padding-bottom:20px; text-align:center; word-break:keep-all;}
.wrap_sector .subheader a			{color:#093E6F; display:block;}
.wrap_sector .subheader a:link		{color:#093E6F;}
.wrap_sector .subheader a:visited	{color:#093E6F;}
.wrap_sector .subheader a:hover		{color:#0373C9;}
.wrap_sector .subheader a:active	{color:#093E6F;}
.wrap_capital_spend	{padding:20px 0;}
.wrap_capital_spend .sector_code_text	{max-width:initial;}

/*	DATA SOURCES	*/
.data_source			{display:flex; justify-content:space-between; padding:10px 0 5px 0;}
.data_source a			{background-color:#182e45; border-radius:4px; color:#fff; display:block; font-size:16px; font-variant:all-small-caps; line-height:20px; padding:10px 0; text-align:center; min-width:15%;}
.data_source a:link		{color:#fff;}
.data_source a:visited	{color:#fff;}
.data_source a:hover	{background-color:#183757; color:#FFC28A;}
.data_source a:active	{color:#fff;}
.data_source a span		{color:#ccc;}

/*	COUNT	*/
span.count				{color:#ccc; font-size:12px; padding-left:10px;}
.wrap_sector span.count	{color:#444; font-weight:normal; padding-left:5px; vertical-align:baseline;}
.wrap_transaction,
.wrap_result			{position:relative;}
.wrap_length			{color:#ddd; font-size:10px; max-width:700px; position:absolute; right:-20px; text-align:right; top:10px;}
.wrap_length span.count	{font-size:10px; padding:0 0 0 5px;}
.length					{display:inline-block; padding-left:20px;}
.wrap_result .wrap_length	{right:20px;}
.wrap_result .length	{min-width:100px;}


/*	TRANSACTION OVERVIEW	*/
.overview .header_section	{display:flex; justify-content:space-between; padding:11px 40px 1px 40px;}
.overview .wrap_length		{display:flex; color:#ddd; font-size:10px; max-width:700px; position:initial; text-align:initial; justify-content:flex-end; flex-wrap:wrap;}
.overview .length			{display:block; padding:0 0 10px 20px;}


/*	DOCUMENTS	*/
a.doc_link:before		{border:1px solid #CCC; color:#CCC; content:"☰"; display:inline-block; margin-right:-24px; padding:2px; vertical-align:top;}
a.doc_link				{background-color:rgba(50,58,64,0.6); border:1px solid #656a6f; border-bottom:0; color:#FFF; display:block; font-size:10px; line-height:1.25em; padding:10px 15px; position:relative;}
.wrap_document a		{color:#fff;}
.wrap_document a:link	{color:#fff;}
.wrap_document a:visited{color:#fff;}
.wrap_document a:hover	{background-color:rgba(77,88,97,0.6);}
.wrap_document a:active	{color:#fff;}
a.doc_link:last-of-type	{border-bottom:1px solid #656a6f;}

.wrap_doc_link	{display:inline-block; padding-left:34px; vertical-align:top;}
span.doc_title,
span.doc_format	{display:inline-block; vertical-align:top;}
span.doc_title	{font-size:14px; font-weight:bold; line-height:1.25em; max-width:600px;}
span.doc_title:nth-of-type(n+2)	{font-style:italic;}
span.doc_desc	{color:#ccc; display:block; font-size:12px; line-height:14px; padding:5px 0;}
span.doc_format	{background-color:rgba(22,24,37,0.6); border-radius:4px; color:#aaa; font-size:10px; font-weight:bold; margin-left:10px; padding:2px 5px;}
span.doc_lang,
span.doc_country{color:#CCC; display:inline-block; font-size:13px; line-height:1.5em; margin:5px 3px 0 0; text-transform:uppercase; vertical-align:top;}
span.doc_country{font-style:italic; text-transform:initial; line-height:1em; vertical-align:bottom;}
span.rep_type	{color:#CCC; display:inline-block; font-size:12px; margin-left:5px; vertical-align:middle;}
span.doc_cat,
span.doc_rec,
span.doc_date	{background-color:rgba(72,79,86,0.6); border-radius:4px; color:#CCC; display:inline-block; font-size:13px; line-height:1.5em; margin:5px 5px 0 0; padding:0 4px; vertical-align:top;}
span.doc_date	{background-color:rgba(48,71,103,1);}
span.doc_rec	{background-color:rgba(22,24,37,0.6);}

/*	CONTACT INFO	*/
.wrap_contact_info					{background-color:rgba(17,46,105,0.9); font-size:16px; line-height:1.5em; margin:0 0 20px -50px; padding:20px 40px 0 40px; width:980px;}
.wrap_contact_info:last-of-type 	{padding-bottom:0;}
.wrap_contact_info:nth-of-type(1) 	{margin-left:-10px; padding-top:30px; width:900px;}
.wrap_contact_info .contact_info	{border-bottom:1px dotted #7481aa; margin-bottom:15px; padding-bottom:15px;}
.wrap_contact_info .contact_info:last-of-type	{border:0; margin-bottom:0; padding-bottom:20px;}
.wrap_contact_org					{font-weight:bold;}
.wrap_contact_name					{font-size:20px; padding-top:10px;}
.wrap_contact_title					{font-size:16px;}
.wrap_contact_tel					{font-size:18px; padding:5px 0;}
.wrap_contact_type					{color:#ccc; font-size:12px; padding-bottom:5px; text-transform:uppercase;}
.wrap_contact_add					{padding-top:5px;}
.wrap_contact_info .narrative:nth-of-type(n+2)	{font-size:16px; font-style:italic; font-weight:normal;}

/*	DATES	*/
.wrap_activity_date					{height:82px; margin-left:-50px; position:relative; width:980px;}
.wrap_activity_date .planned_start,
.wrap_activity_date .actual_start,
.wrap_activity_date .planned_end,
.wrap_activity_date .actual_end		{color:#151515; display:inline-block; font-size:20px; height:40px; line-height:18px; min-height:40px; padding:10px 40px;}
.wrap_activity_date div span		{color:#552d03; display:inline-block; font-size:13px; font-weight:bold; line-height:18px; min-width:165px; padding-right:10px; text-transform:uppercase; vertical-align:bottom;}
.wrap_activity_date .planned_start	{background-color:#f48a1a; left:0; margin:1px 1px 0 0; position:absolute; top:0; width:489px;}
.wrap_activity_date .planned_end	{background-color:#f48a1a; margin:1px 0 0 0; position:absolute; right:0; text-align:right; top:0; width:490px;}
.wrap_activity_date .actual_start	{background-color:#ffa443; bottom:0; left:0; margin:1px 1px 0 0; position:absolute; width:489px;}
.wrap_activity_date .actual_end		{background-color:#ffa443; bottom:0; margin:1px 0 0 0; position:absolute; right:0; text-align:right; width:490px;}
.activity_date_bar					{background-color:#ccc; height:10px; margin-left:-40px; max-height:10px; position:relative; width:960px;}
.activity_date_overlay				{background-color:#3d72dd; height:10px; max-height:10px; position:relative;}
.activity_date_overlay:after		{background-color:#fff; border:3px solid #3d72dd; border-radius:15px; content:""; height:10px; position:absolute; right:-5px; top:-4px; width:10px;}

/*	ACTIVITY STATUS	*/
.wrap_activity_status		{background-color:#fff; color:#444; font-size:16px; margin-left:-40px; padding:20px 0; text-align:center; width:960px;}
.wrap_activity_status span	{font-size:13px; font-weight:bold; text-transform:uppercase;}
.status_desc				{font-size:12px; margin:0 auto; padding-top:5px;}

/*	TABLES	*/
td .currency	{color:#ccc; font-size:10px; line-height:12px;}
.value			{text-align:right;}
.wrap_tab		{border-bottom:1px solid #666; margin-bottom:5px; padding-bottom:5px;}
.wrap_tab:last-of-type	{border:0;}
.tab_text,
.tab_currency	{box-sizing:border-box; display:inline-block; line-height:1.25em; vertical-align:top; width:75%;}
.tab_currency	{color:#ccc; font-size:12px; padding-left:30px; text-align:right; width:25%;}
.tab_currency div {font-size:10px;}
.tab_text		{word-break:keep-all;}

/*	PROVIDER, RECEIVER ORG	*/
.type			{background-color:rgba(72,79,86,0.6); border-radius:4px; color:#CCC; font-size:11px; margin:0 auto; margin-left:-5px; padding:2px 4px;}
.type.secondary	{background-color:#304767; color:#ddd;}
.ref			{color:#CCC; font-family:monospace; font-size:10px; line-height:initial; margin:0 auto;}
.ref > *		{vertical-align:baseline;}
.ref span		{color:#fff;}
.ref span.withdrawn					{background-color:#545e73; color:#ddd; font-size:10px;}
.org-type		{margin-top:5px;}
td.receiver div,
td.provider div,
td.part_org_ref div,
td.loc_name div						{line-height:10px; padding-bottom:2px;}
td.part_org_ref .part_org_id span a	{padding-left:5px;}		/*	Left padding so ID lines up	*/

	<div class="wrap_description">
		<div class="header" title="Unstructured, long description of the activity">General</div>
<div class="text"><div class="narrative">Le Programme de viabilité budgétaire et de résilience économique (FSERP) est conçu comme une série programmatique de deux opérations consécutives d’appui budgétaire général (ABG).  Cet appui permettra à la République démocratique de São Tomé-et-Príncipe de renforcer la viabilité budgétaire et la résilience économique grâce à l’amélioration des systèmes de Gestion des finances publiques (GFP) et de l’efficacité dans le secteur de l’énergie. Le programme soutiendra le gouvernement dans ses efforts de réforme en vue d’accélérer la croissance économique en créant un environnement plus propice au secteur privé, en améliorant la transparence et la responsabilité, et en favorisant la bonne gouvernance dans le secteur de l’énergie, tout en renforçant la résilience climatique. L’ensemble des réformes prévues au titre du programme proposé s’articulent autour de deux composantes qui se renforcent mutuellement et se complètent. La Composante 1 (« Amélioration de la transparence et de la viabilité budgétaires »), contribuera à l’augmentation des recettes nationales, à l’amélioration de l’efficacité des dépenses publiques et au renforcement de la transparence et de la viabilité de la dette. Quant à la Composante 2 (« Amélioration de la gouvernance du secteur de l’énergie et de la transition vers les énergies renouvelables »), elle soutiendra les réformes dans le secteur de l’énergie et contribuera à la transition vers l’énergie verte. Le projet contribue au financement climatique, avec une enveloppe de 2 millions USD du montant total approuvé dédiée à l’atténuation.</div><div class="narrative">The Fiscal Sustainability and Economic Resilience Program (FSERP) is designed as a programmatic series of two consecutive General Budget Support (GBS) operations.  This support will enable the Democratic Republic of São Tomé and Príncipe to strengthen fiscal sustainability and economic resilience by improving Public Financial Management (PFM) systems and efficiency in the energy sector. The programme will support the Government in its efforts to implement reforms to accelerate economic growth by creating a more conducive environment for the private sector, enhancing transparency and accountability, and boosting governance in the energy sector while building climate resilience. The set of reforms under the proposed program is organized around two mutually reinforcing and complementary components. Component 1, Improving fiscal transparency and sustainability, will support enhancing domestic revenue, improving public expenditure efficiency, and enhancing debt transparency and sustainability. Component 2, Improving energy sector governance and transition to renewable energy, will support reforms in the energy sector and help in transitioning to green energy. The project contributes to climate finance, with 2 million USD of the total approved amount dedicated to mitigation.</div>
</div>
<div class="header" title="Details of groups that are intended to benefit from the activity">Target Groups</div>
<div class="text"><div class="narrative">Les bénéficiaires directs du programme sont le Ministère du Plan, des Finances et de l’Économie bleue (MPFEA), par le biais de l’apport de ressources au Trésor pour l’exécution du budget national. Les ressources permettront de réduire le déficit budgétaire et d’augmenter les réserves de change. L’accroissement des réserves de change est essentiel à l’importation de biens essentiels et à l’amélioration de la performance du secteur de l’énergie. Le programme profitera indirectement à tous les citoyens de STP, dans la mesure où un environnement des affaires plus favorable se traduira par la croissance et la création d’emplois ; l’amélioration de la transparence budgétaire permettra de fournir des services publics meilleurs et plus nombreux. Par ailleurs, le renforcement de la résilience énergétique et climatique permettra de créer davantage d’opportunités d’emplois et de rendre l’habitat plus sûr.</div><div class="narrative">The direct beneficiaries of the program are the Ministry of Planning, Finance and the Blue Economy (MPFEA), through the provision of resources to the Treasury for the execution of the national budget. The resources will be used to reduce the budget deficit and increase foreign exchange reserves. Increased foreign exchange reserves are essential for importing essential goods and improving the performance of the energy sector. The program will indirectly benefit all STP citizens, insofar as a more favorable business environment will translate into growth and job creation; improved fiscal transparency will enable the provision of more and better public services. In addition, strengthening energy and climate resilience will create more job opportunities and make housing safer.</div>
</div>
<div class="header" title="Specific objectives for the activity, e.g. taken from logical framework">Objectives</div>
<div class="text"><div class="narrative">L’objectif du programme est d’améliorer la viabilité budgétaire et la gouvernance du secteur énergétique grâce à des réformes renforcées du secteur énergétique des systèmes de Gestion des finances publiques (GFP).</div><div class="narrative">The objective of the program is to improve fiscal sustainability and energy sector governance through strengthened energy sector reforms of Public Financial Management (PFM) systems.</div>
</div>
